explanation: Generated 25 eta-channel points at W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0, with phi* evenly spaced from 0 through 345 degrees inclusive (nominal spacing 14.375 degrees; serialized to the validated one-decimal input format). EXCLURAD requires at most 10 points per input, so the grid is chunked 10/10/5. Preflight passed all 25 points. Full O(alpha) radiative corrections and the eta campaign defaults were used: 6.53 GeV beam energy and vcut=0.166 GeV^2. Beam energy was not supplied and radiative corrections are beam-energy dependent; regenerate if a different experimental beam energy is intended.
